scripts.check:all: npm run check:types && npm run prettier:check && npm run lint:check && npm run check:boundary && npm run check:boundary:ast && npm run check:banned-deps && npm run check:native-io
scripts.check:banned-deps: node -e "const pkg = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('packages/300.engine/package.json', 'utf8')); const banned = ['remotion', '@remotion/core', '@remotion/cli', 'react', 'child_process', '@cloudflare/workers-types']; const found = Object.keys({...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies}).filter(d => banned.includes(d)); if (found.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL: Banned dependencies in packages/300.engine:', found); process.exit(1); } console.log('PASS: Zero banned dependencies in packages/300.engine.');"
scripts.check:preflight: npm run check:runner-boundary && npm run check:harness-boundary && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:ascii
scripts.check:zero-runtime: node -e "const pkg = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); if (pkg.dependencies && Object.keys(pkg.dependencies).length > 0) { console.error('FAIL: Root dependencies must be empty'); process.exit(1); } console.log('PASS: Zero root runtime dependencies verified');"
scripts.check:anti-gaming: npm run overlay:tests && npm run test:golden-failures && npm run check:red-green
scripts.gauntlet: npm run check:runner-boundary && npm run check:all && npm run test:pure && npm run check:anti-gaming
scripts.fix: npm run prettier:fix && npm run lint:fix
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:ts
